description.value: Canffle is a waffle-focused restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver, established in 2020, specializing in waffles made from traditional recipes with fresh ingredients. The spot offers indoor seating and a pickup/online order option, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor.
